info.name: UOB Library Management API
info.description:
End-to-end tests for the Library Management Web API (.NET 8).

1. Start the API: `dotnet run --project src/LibraryManagement.Api` (http://localhost:5080).
2. Select the **UOB Library API - Local** environment.
3. Run the whole collection with the **Collection Runner**, in order.

Each run creates its own books and members (unique ISBNs and emails from `runId`), so it can be run repeatedly and doesn't depend on the seed data. Ids are passed between requests through collection variables.

item.name: 3. Loans: happy path
item.description: Borrow, check stock, list, history and return.

exec: pm.test("Location header points to the loan", () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Location")).to.include("/api/loans/"));
pm.test("Loan is Active and not overdue", () => { pm.expect(j.status).to.eql("Active"); pm.expect(j.daysOverdue).to.eql(0); });
pm.test("Includes book and member names", () => { pm.expect(j.bookTitle).to.include("Postman Test Book A"); pm.expect(j.memberName).to.eql("Alice Postman"); });
pm.test("Returned on time: no fine", () => pm.expect(j.fineAmount).to.eql(0));
pm.test("Copy is back (Premium loan still out): 2 available", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().availableCopies).to.eql(2));
pm.test("Every item is Overdue", () => pm.response.json().items.forEach(l => pm.expect(l.status).to.eql("Overdue")));

request.description: Overdue can't be created from Postman without waiting 14+ days, so this only checks that the filter works. Overdue rules are covered by the automated tests (TestClock).
